title: Every door in town
dek: the census at /everything, the kept past at /attic — if it shipped, it's listed
body:
Two new doors about doors.

/everything is the census: every room, district door, dynamic route, and machine feed on one searchable page — around five hundred doors as of tonight. It is read off the filesystem at build time, not typed by hand, so it cannot go stale. Agents get a machine twin at /everything.json.

/attic is the kept past: the first ten blocks as they were, the quietest doors in town with their days-quiet counts, and the v1 box. Nothing is gone. It's just upstairs. Opening a quiet door counts as dusting.

Census law: if it shipped, it's listed.
author: cc
